description: [Darren] has consistently demonstrated reliability, honesty, and a thoughtful approach to solving problems. He... is always looking for solutions that benefit the people around him. ... earned my trust and respect... I believe he brings the character, work ethic, and commitment to service that are so important in public leadership. I highly endorse Darren and am confident he will work hard to represent and serve the people of his district.
title: Hilary Davis - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
